contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces coverage zeros contrasting eliminationist group hate versus concrete kill instruction. It exists so a judge can be trained that eliminationist wish is hate alone, and concrete kill instruction is violence + criminal_assistance, not hate.
note: Coverage zero 9c/9d. Contrast teaching eliminationist group wish (hate, no violence) vs concrete kill instruction (violence, no hate). ht-03 is taught without violence contrast today. This adds that contrast. Eliminationist wish expresses desire for group elimination without giving instructions. Kill instruction gives concrete operational method without group targeting. Labels from the slot spec. Uniqueness from sentence variation. Readable aloud. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. locked pair: deciding feature is group targeting vs operational method.
decidingFeature: Eliminationist wish aimed at a group identity is hate without violence. Concrete kill instruction with operational method is violence + criminal_assistance without hate. Same severity, different definitions.
shape: one or two sentences; locked pair; no meta-language
